exposure: educational intervention based on the Health Belief Model (HBM)
cohort: 180 primigravida women with healthy and uncomplicated pregnancies between 28-32 weeks of gestational age were recruited for the study.
finding: An educational intervention based on the Health Belief Model significantly increased the selection of normal vaginal delivery among pregnant women.
mod_finding: The educational intervention based on the Health Belief Model led to a significant increase in the selection of normal vaginal delivery among participants.
